m1_buffered_isolated_margin.hypothesis: allocate more isolated margin so liquidation sits another stop-risk distance beyond the stop for immediate entries; offline FOK remains safe on initial 20x margin

h4_collateral_neutralized_bear_alpha.hypothesis: bearish manual invocations short enough BTCUSD to neutralize BTC collateral delta plus original bearish alpha, using whole-account stop risk; bullish path unchanged

stop_first_upper_bound.hypothesis: diagnostic only: whenever an hourly bar opens above a long stop and later touches both stop and liquidation, assume stop precedes liquidation
stop_first_upper_bound.decision: not a production rule; shows liquidation ordering is not the main economic blocker

interpretation: Extra isolated margin does not improve the frozen-window economics.
A direct inverse-contract collateral-neutralization overlay worsens return and liquidation count.
Even eliminating all eight hourly liquidation outcomes barely changes CAGR/MDD, so coarse stop-vs-liquidation ordering is not the main source of the 77% drawdown.
BTC collateral beta remains the dominant structural issue; a stable-settlement linear perpetual should be evaluated before further inverse-contract parameter work.
